::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 3d 1878  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 60
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

Should not the title be ['The Story of the Moors and Christians in Spain'](cmy_books/cmybook_126.qmd) <u>A</u> Story looks as if it were fiction

Yours truly
C M Yonge		

I shall send the proof tomorrow

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
